summary: A high growth rate thermal ALD process for CeO x films using (N-iPr-AMD)3Ce and O3 as precursors was developed. The process showed ideal self-limiting deposition behaviors with a high and constant growth rate of * 2.8 A˚ /cycle at 220–255 /C176C. The films exhibited good purity, smoothness, and uniform conformal coverage on complex structures.
evidence: In this paper, a novel approach was studied to fabricate ALD CeO x films with amidinato-cerium (N- iPr-AMD)3Ce and O3 as precursors. Ideal self-limiting deposition behaviors were found for the prepared films. The purity and surface morphology of the as-grown CeO x films, which possessed a high and constant growth rate of * 2.8 A˚ /cycle at 220–255 /C176C, were confirmed by XPS, XRD, SEM and AFM.
